book.name: Ioane
book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ḡoereꞌa Vazeo Reiro
Ḡadaheḡano Ḡoere rae huneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa radiunu. Ḡoere aꞌe Badiꞌa teite radiunu ebu Ḡoere eꞌe Badiꞌa.
Aniꞌe ꞌizema raha zu adure ꞌadi haḡaogano Badiꞌa teite radiunu.
Badiꞌaꞌa anionoꞌo ḡau niduꞌa haḡairo. Anionoꞌo mene haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa ꞌahogaꞌe oꞌoꞌa.
Ani zamaḡano ḡaboneḡeta. Ḡabone eꞌeꞌa vaze agazeꞌeteꞌe agaḡa.
Agaḡaꞌe uzabo zamaḡano agaruꞌohe, u uzaboꞌe agaḡa vinoga mene idararo.
Badiꞌaꞌa vaze ꞌahoga tuḡuniro. Ani niꞌe Ioane.
Aniꞌe agaḡa eꞌe moneo vaze ihozifine ebu ze ani ḡoere egadu agaḡa mazao fifine ariro.
Ioaneꞌe mene eꞌe agaḡa, rehano agaḡa eꞌe moneo ihozoga veize ariro.
Agaḡaꞌe raha ꞌada ariro. Aniꞌe agaḡa huga ebu vaze niduꞌa agaziro.
Aniꞌe raha ꞌahao radiro ebu raha ꞌadiꞌe ani mazaonoꞌo haḡairo. Rehano raha azaḡaniꞌa ani mene ederiro.
Aniꞌe ane haba ariro, rehano ani haba azaḡaniꞌa mene mae ḡihiniro.
U iniuꞌa ani mae ḡihinadu ani mazao fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga reiteꞌe gigiꞌaḡa ziniro.
Ze Badiꞌa ubugaubuga raꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene vouḡaze ruonoꞌo, ga mene vaze uraonoꞌo, ga mene vazeꞌa toganiroteꞌe uꞌano, rehano Badiꞌa urao zeꞌe ane ubugaubuga rae reiro.
Ḡoereꞌe vazeo reiro ebu emeḡe boꞌaḡano radiro. Eme aniꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ederiro. Aniꞌe Badiꞌa Ubuga Tibuhuga, ḡihiꞌa hune rae reiro. Aniꞌe vaze zamare borofiro zu ḡoere huga reiro.

Ioaneꞌa ani moneo rae fureneꞌenaꞌa, ḡihau ḡoeriro, “E ibite ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Eḡe ḡaruna ariteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe vitihoga ḡihiꞌaḡa, mazaḡa e ꞌizema fureranogano aniꞌe amahi radiro.' Eḡeꞌa ꞌouge ziroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ꞌadi eꞌe.”
Aniꞌe eme zamare borofeꞌe ꞌahine, emeḡe niduꞌa manohuga rifiꞌohe, ebu emeꞌa barebare manohuga hideꞌohe.
Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe Moseonoꞌo rifiro, u Badiꞌaꞌa Iesu Keriso uꞌano, emeḡe mazao manoḡa fureniro zu ḡoere huga ihofiro.
Badiꞌaꞌe vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa mene horoniro. Rehano Ubuga tibuhuga, Moga uhiḡano radiuꞌeteꞌeꞌa Badiꞌa moneo vaze ihoziro. Aniꞌe Badiꞌa.
Ioaneꞌe Mene Keriso
Iuda azaḡa boroboroꞌa dibuꞌo azaḡa zu Levi urabo azaḡa Ierusalemaonoꞌo Ioane vaḡe tuḡuziro. Ebu zeḡeꞌa Ioane ḡadiniro, “Ḡaꞌe iniu?” ꞌOugadu Ioaneꞌa ꞌahige rae fureniro.
Aniꞌe ḡau ꞌahoga zu mene ꞌuꞌuru ḡoeriro ebu huga daꞌo deheru rae fureniro, “Eꞌe mene Keriso.”

Ebu zeḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Tena ḡa iniu? Ḡa Eliahe?” Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “E mene.” Ze bare ḡadiniro, “Peroveta vazeḡa boro ꞌahoganiꞌa ariꞌuma rae ibite rae fureniro. Ḡaꞌe peroveta vazeḡa eꞌehe?” Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Mene.”
Ḡonagano zeḡeꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌe iniu? Ihofoꞌi, ꞌougine eme baradu emeḡe tuḡufateꞌe azaḡa mazao ḡaꞌe iniu rae ziꞌuma. Ḡa ḡae bare moneo nouge rae raꞌohe?”
Ioaneꞌa peroveta vazeḡa Isaiaꞌa reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa hina naenaeziro,
Ioane ḡadiniroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano nuꞌe Farisea azaḡaniꞌa tuḡuziroteꞌe azaḡa.
Zeꞌa Ioane ḡadiniro, “Ḡaꞌe mene Keriso, mene Elia zu mene peroveta vazeḡa eꞌe reine, nougadu vaze babatisoziꞌohe?”
Ioaneꞌa naenaeziro, “Eꞌe vu hina babatisoziꞌohe. Rehano zae boꞌaḡano zaeꞌa mene edereꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa edauꞌohe.
Aniꞌe eḡe ḡaruna areꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa zu eḡe vitihoga. Eḡe'a ani tamaka miniḡa fuhiꞌeꞌeteꞌe tuḡureḡa vazeḡa rae rouga zuni mene idaḡa.”
ꞌAhi niduꞌa Ioridana vuḡa moneafa Betania habaꞌano fureraro. Deꞌea Ioaneꞌa babatisozinu.
Badiꞌa Mamoe Ubuga
Irarirotene, Ioaneꞌe Iesuꞌa ani vaḡe ariroteꞌe horonadu reiro, “Badiꞌa Mamoe Ubuga ḡianoꞌi! Aniꞌe raha ꞌada haḡai sauꞌa niduꞌa odohe onameꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.
Ibite e ani moneo ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Eḡe ḡaruna ariteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe vitihoga ḡihiꞌaḡa, mazaḡa e ꞌizema fureranogano aniꞌe amahi radiunu.'
E aniꞌe mene ederiro. Rehano Isaraela azaḡaniꞌa ani ederifine, e aradu vu hina babatisoziꞌohe.”
Ebu Ioaneꞌa bare rae fureniro, “E Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa Tubugo niniḡa teige adureonoꞌo ovadu ani rana kame radiuꞌeteꞌe horoniro.

E aniꞌe mene ederiro. Rehano e vu hina babatisozoga veize tuḡuhiroteꞌe Badiꞌaḡaniꞌa ꞌahige rae ihohiro, 'Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa adureonoꞌo ovadu vaze ꞌahoga rana kame radoga horonoꞌidene, aniꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡa hina babatisoziteꞌe vazeḡa rae ederoꞌi.'
E hube hune ꞌouge horonadu aniꞌe Badiꞌa Ubuga rae fureneꞌohe.”
Iesu Tahiꞌa Ibiꞌa
Irarirotene, Ioaneꞌe ane tahiꞌa aheu teite eꞌe habaꞌano bare edau radiunu.
Ebu Iesuꞌa eꞌea vitau onamoga horonirotene, aniꞌa reiro, “Badiꞌa Mamoe Ubuga ḡianoꞌi!”
Ioane tahiꞌa aheuꞌa ani ḡoere egadu Iesu hegotiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa tehadu ze ani hegoteꞌeteꞌe horozadu ziro, “Za nagini urateꞌohe?” Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Rabi, ḡa nouma radiuꞌohe?” (Rabi hugaꞌe Ihore Vazeḡa.)
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡe teite onamine, horoniꞌuma.” Ebu ze onamadu Iesuꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe habaꞌa horoniro, ebu eꞌe mada niduga eꞌea ane teite radiro. Aꞌe ḡorava mone mada ḡazaḡa reiro.
Ioane ḡoere egadu Iesu hegotiroteꞌe vazeḡa aheu boꞌaḡano ꞌahogaꞌe Anderea. Aniꞌe Simona Petero negoḡa.
Ani ibite negoḡa Simona vaḡe onamadu niro, “Eme Mesia horoneha.” (Mesia ḡoere ꞌahogaꞌe Keriso.)
Ebu Andereaꞌa Simona Iesu vaḡe zamahu onamiro. Iesuꞌa ani ḡianadu niro, “Ḡaꞌe Ioane ubuga, Simona. Rehano Kefa rae huḡadiꞌuma.” (Kefa, ni ꞌahogaꞌe Petero.
Filipi zu Natanaela Huziro
Irarirotene, Iesuꞌe Galilea habaꞌa onamihi reiro. Ani ꞌizema onamogano Filipi vaḡe onamadu niro, “Eḡe hegotoꞌi.”
Filipiꞌe Betesaida vazeḡa, ebu Anderea zu Petero teite ne tiba.

Ebu Filipiꞌa Natanaela vaḡe onamadu niro, “Eme Moseꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa zamaḡano mirihiroteꞌe, zu peroveta azaḡaniꞌa zeḡe buka zamaḡano mirihiroteꞌe vazeḡa horoneha. Aniꞌe Iosefa ubuga, Nazareta vazeḡa Iesu.”
Ebu Natanaelaꞌa naenaeniro, “Nazaretaꞌe ne komeꞌa! Eꞌea nagini manoḡaniꞌa fureraꞌuma?” Filipiꞌa niro, “Aradu ḡianoꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌe Natanaelaꞌa ani vaḡe areꞌeteꞌe horonirotene, Natanaela moneo ḡoeriro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe hube hune Isaraela vazeḡa. Ani mazaoꞌe ḡuriro ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa.”
Natanaelaꞌa ḡadiniro, “Ḡaꞌe e nougenouge edereꞌohe?” Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Filipiꞌa ꞌizema huḡadogano, ḡa figi ireḡa ꞌuꞌuḡano radiuꞌenogano horoꞌeha.”
Ebu Natanaelaꞌa niro, “Rabi, ḡaꞌe Badiꞌa Ubuga! Isaraela azaḡa kini!”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Eḡeꞌa ḡaꞌe figi ireḡa ꞌuꞌuḡano radateꞌea horoꞌeha rae radu ḡa eḡe mazao fieꞌehe? Rehano ḡa ꞌahi ufeta vitinoga ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa horoniꞌuma.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, za adureꞌa bohatanadu Badiꞌa tuḡure viganiꞌa Vaze Ubuga rana iteꞌeteꞌe zu ovoeꞌeteꞌe horoniꞌuma.”
